subject: Request: Quarterly invoicing + net-60 payment cadence (Gridline Health)
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily@gridlinehealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@gridlinehealth.com, Legal (Gridline) <legal@gridlinehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: switch to quarterly invoicing + net-60 payment cadence

Hi Alex,

Hope you’re doing well — we had a quick ask from our finance team. Gridline is moving several vendor payments to a quarterly billing cycle to simplify our AP process. For Redwood, AP would prefer to receive consolidated invoices every quarter and pay on net-60 from invoice date (so effectively payment 60 days after the quarter invoice).

We understand this is non-standard. We can provide an AP intake form and a short SOW amendment if needed (attached). From a timelines perspective, we’re hoping to start this on the Q3 billing run.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept quarterly consolidated invoices with net-60 payment terms and any required approvals or paperwork? If we need to route this to someone, please let us know.

Thanks — appreciate it.

Emily Park
Head of Finance Operations
Gridline Health
attachments: Gridline_AP_Form.pdf, SOW_Redwood_Gridline_v3.docx
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily@gridlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: switch to quarterly invoicing + net-60 payment cadence

Hi Emily — thanks for the note and the attachments.

Quick answer: this is possible but will require a short internal approval (non-standard payment cadence + impact to cashflow). I’ve looped in Marissa (AM) and Ben (Finance) to assess commercial/credit impact and confirm any pricing or SLA implications.

Proposed next steps:
- Alex: capture AP form and confirm start quarter (you mentioned Q3)
- Marissa: confirm deal/account status for approval and any discount/terms trade-off
- Ben: finance to sign off on credit & cashflow (we’ll need to confirm whether we require a prepayment, small discount, or PO hold)

Can we target a decision by EOD Monday (15 Jun) so Gridline can plan? If you prefer a quick call, I can set one up.

Thanks,
Alex
Senior Account Executive\Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: switch to quarterly invoicing + net-60 payment cadence

Forwarding Gridline’s AP request and attachments. Key facts: annual contract ~ $420k ARR, current monthly invoices, no outstanding credits, renewed last quarter.

My read: quarterly consolidated invoices would reduce our admin overhead but defers cash collection (worst-case ~90 days additional DSO for some invoices). Gridline is willing to sign an amendment and provide an official PO. Options to propose:
- Accept as-is (quarterly invoices, net-60) — Finance approval required
- Accept with a small 1.5% invoice processing fee or early-payment discount (e.g., 1% for payment within 30 days)
- Require 50% prepayment upfront, balance net-30 after invoice (likely not acceptable to them)

If Ben confirms credit ok, I’m comfortable proposing the 1% early-pay discount option to protect cash. Karthik, any thoughts on sales/contract impact?

Marissa Cole
Account Manager\Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: switch to quarterly invoicing + net-60 payment cadence

Thanks for the context. I ran a quick credit check and Gridline’s payment history is clean; credit limit can be extended to cover one quarter in arrears. That said, committing to net-60 from a quarterly invoice means our DSO could increase by ~45 days on average — impact to cashflow is material but manageable within current reserves.

Approval parameters I’d need to sign off:
1) Legal amendment (SOW addendum) that acknowledges the quarterly cadence and exact invoice dates.
2) Gridline to provide a PO/commitment for at least the next two quarters.
3) We ask for either a 1% early-pay discount (if they pay within 30 days) OR a small 0.75% processing fee added to the invoice if paid after 60 days.

If we get the PO and the amendment, I can approve this as a Finance sign-off. Marissa/Alex — please confirm you can get the PO and push for the 1% early-pay discount option in negotiations.

Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Operations (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily@gridlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: switch to quarterly invoicing + net-60 payment cadence

Hi Emily — quick update from our side and a couple of asks so we can finalize:

1) Finance (Ben) can approve the quarterly invoice cadence if Gridline provides a PO covering the next two quarters and signs a short amendment to the SOW.
2) We would like to offer a 1% early-pay discount if Gridline pays within 30 days of invoice. Alternatively, a 0.75% processing fee will apply for payments after net-60.

Can you confirm whether Gridline can provide the PO and which discount/fee option you prefer? Once confirmed, I’ll route the amendment for Legal and we can push a DocuSign for signatures.

Thanks,
Alex
From: Emily Park <emily@gridlinehealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@gridlinehealth.com, Legal (Gridline) <legal@gridlinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: switch to quarterly invoicing + net-60 payment cadence

Alex — thanks for the quick turnaround. Gridline can provide a PO that covers the next two quarters and we prefer the 1% early-pay discount (we expect AP will usually pay within 30 days). Please route the amendment and PO instructions; AP will attach the PO to the first consolidated invoice.

Emily
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: (none)
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Final approval: Gridline quarterly invoicing (net-60) — sign-off

Alex/Marissa — I’ve reviewed the PO condition and the credit profile. Finance approves the quarterly invoicing with net-60 on the following binding conditions:

1) Gridline provides a PO covering at least two quarters before the first consolidated invoice is issued.
2) An amendment to the SOW reflecting the cadence is signed via DocuSign (please include the early-pay discount clause: 1% if paid within 30 days; otherwise standard net-60 applies with 0.75% processing fee optional on delinquency).
3) Accounts Receivable to flag the account for 30/60/90 collection cadence and report any materially late payments to Revenue Ops immediately.

Marissa, please prepare the amendment and the DocuSign envelope; Alex, coordinate for the PO. Once I see the PO and signed amendment, Finance will adjust the billing schedule.

Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Operations (acting)
Redwood Inference
